digest.component_or_area: contribution flow and code review documentation
propositions: Gerrit WIP state must be documented as the enforcement mechanism for holding changes with known unresolved issues, with both push-time (%wip) and post-push (REST endpoint) forms and their release paths.

The WIP hold rule must be documented in CONTRIBUTING.md §2d as the authoritative reference, mirrored in passing-code-review.md and linked from AGENTS.md so it is reachable through all author-facing surfaces.
The rationale for WIP marking must explain that ticket comments and session logs are advisory and invisible to submitters, while WIP is structurally enforced against all submission attempts.
Tests must assert the rule presence and reachability through packaged guide registry mappings, not file paths alone, and must fail when the rule is removed.
